import Mathlib

def total_weight (selected : List Bool) (weights : List Nat) : Nat :=
  match selected, weights with
  | [], _ => 0
  | _, [] => 0
  | b :: bs, w :: ws => (if b then w else 0) + total_weight bs ws

def total_value (selected : List Bool) (values : List Nat) : Nat :=
  match selected, values with
  | [], _ => 0
  | _, [] => 0
  | b :: bs, v :: vs => (if b then v else 0) + total_value bs vs

def is_valid_strategy (selected : List Bool) (weights : List Nat) (capacity : Nat) : Prop :=
  selected.length = weights.length ∧
  total_weight selected weights ≤ capacity

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def knapsack_01_precond (weights values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  weights.length = values.length
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- The 0/1 knapsack recurrence: best value obtainable from the items
    `(ws, vs)` with remaining capacity `c` (either skip the first item, or
    take it when it fits). -/
def knapAux : List Nat → List Nat → Nat → Nat
  | [], _, _ => 0
  | _ :: _, [], _ => 0
  | w :: ws, v :: vs, c =>
      max (knapAux ws vs c) (if w ≤ c then v + knapAux ws vs (c - w) else 0)

/-- Bottom-up dynamic programming table for 0/1 knapsack: `knapRow ws vs cap`
    is the row of length `cap + 1` whose `c`-th entry is the best value
    obtainable from the items `(ws, vs)` with capacity `c`.  Each item is
    processed once, producing a new row from the previous one. -/
def knapRow : List Nat → List Nat → Nat → List Nat
  | [], _, cap => List.replicate (cap + 1) 0
  | _ :: _, [], cap => List.replicate (cap + 1) 0
  | w :: ws, v :: vs, cap =>
      let prev := knapRow ws vs cap
      (List.range (cap + 1)).map fun c =>
        max (prev.getD c 0) (if w ≤ c then v + prev.getD (c - w) 0 else 0)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def knapsack_01 (weights values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat)
    (h_precond : knapsack_01_precond weights values capacity) : Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (knapRow weights values capacity).getD capacity 0
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def knapsack_01_postcond (weights values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat) (result : Nat)
    (_ : knapsack_01_precond weights values capacity) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ selected, is_valid_strategy selected weights capacity → total_value selected values ≤ result) ∧
  (∃ selected, is_valid_strategy selected weights capacity ∧ total_value selected values = result)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem total_value_nil_right (s : List Bool) : total_value s [] = 0 := by
  cases s <;> rfl

theorem total_weight_replicate_false (n : Nat) (ws : List Nat) :
    total_weight (List.replicate n false) ws = 0 := by
  induction n generalizing ws with
  | zero => cases ws <;> rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    cases ws with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons w ws => simp [List.replicate_succ, total_weight, ih]

theorem total_weight_false_cons (w : Nat) (ws : List Nat) (s : List Bool) :
    total_weight (false :: s) (w :: ws) = total_weight s ws := by
  simp [total_weight]

theorem knapAux_ub : ∀ (ws vs : List Nat) (c : Nat) (s : List Bool),
    s.length = ws.length → total_weight s ws ≤ c → total_value s vs ≤ knapAux ws vs c := by
  intro ws
  induction ws with
  | nil =>
    intro vs c s hlen _
    cases s with
    | nil => simp [knapAux, total_value]
    | cons b bs => simp at hlen
  | cons w ws ih =>
    intro vs c s hlen hw
    cases vs with
    | nil => simp [total_value_nil_right, knapAux]
    | cons v vs =>
      cases s with
      | nil => simp at hlen
      | cons b bs =>
        simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at hlen
        simp only [total_weight] at hw
        cases b with
        | false =>
          have hw' : total_weight bs ws ≤ c := by simpa using hw
          have h1 : total_value (false :: bs) (v :: vs) = total_value bs vs := by
            simp [total_value]
          rw [h1]
          simp only [knapAux]
          exact le_trans (ih vs c bs hlen hw') (le_max_left _ _)
        | true =>
          simp only [if_true] at hw
          have hwc : w ≤ c := le_trans (Nat.le_add_right w _) hw
          have hrest : total_weight bs ws ≤ c - w := by omega
          have hIH := ih vs (c - w) bs hlen hrest
          have hstep : total_value (true :: bs) (v :: vs) ≤
              (if w ≤ c then v + knapAux ws vs (c - w) else 0) := by
            simp only [total_value, if_true, if_pos hwc]
            omega
          exact le_trans hstep (le_max_right _ _)

theorem knapAux_ex : ∀ (ws vs : List Nat) (c : Nat),
    ∃ s : List Bool, s.length = ws.length ∧ total_weight s ws ≤ c ∧
      total_value s vs = knapAux ws vs c := by
  intro ws
  induction ws with
  | nil =>
    intro vs c
    exact ⟨[], rfl, by simp [total_weight], by simp [knapAux, total_value]⟩
  | cons w ws ih =>
    intro vs c
    cases vs with
    | nil =>
      refine ⟨List.replicate (w :: ws).length false, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [total_weight_replicate_false]; exact Nat.zero_le _
      · rw [total_value_nil_right]; simp [knapAux]
    | cons v vs =>
      by_cases hwc : w ≤ c
      · rcases le_total (if w ≤ c then v + knapAux ws vs (c - w) else 0)
          (knapAux ws vs c) with hcase | hcase
        · obtain ⟨s, hl, hwt, hv⟩ := ih vs c
          refine ⟨false :: s, by simp [hl], by rw [total_weight_false_cons]; exact hwt, ?_⟩
          have h1 : total_value (false :: s) (v :: vs) = total_value s vs := by
            simp [total_value]
          rw [h1, hv]
          simp only [knapAux]
          exact (max_eq_left hcase).symm
        · obtain ⟨s, hl, hwt, hv⟩ := ih vs (c - w)
          refine ⟨true :: s, by simp [hl], ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp only [total_weight, if_true]; omega
          · simp only [total_value, if_true, knapAux]
            rw [hv, max_eq_right hcase, if_pos hwc]
      · obtain ⟨s, hl, hwt, hv⟩ := ih vs c
        refine ⟨false :: s, by simp [hl], by rw [total_weight_false_cons]; exact hwt, ?_⟩
        have h1 : total_value (false :: s) (v :: vs) = total_value s vs := by
          simp [total_value]
        rw [h1, hv]
        simp only [knapAux, if_neg hwc]
        simp
theorem getD_replicate_zero (n c : Nat) : (List.replicate n (0 : Nat)).getD c 0 = 0 := by
  rcases lt_or_ge c n with h | h
  · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa using h)]
    simp
  · rw [List.getD_eq_default]
    simpa using h

theorem getD_map_range (f : Nat → Nat) (n c : Nat) (h : c < n) :
    ((List.range n).map f).getD c 0 = f c := by
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa using h)]
  simp

/-- The dynamic-programming table agrees with the knapsack recurrence. -/
theorem knapRow_getD : ∀ (ws vs : List Nat) (cap c : Nat), c ≤ cap →
    (knapRow ws vs cap).getD c 0 = knapAux ws vs c := by
  intro ws
  induction ws with
  | nil =>
    intro vs cap c _
    simp [knapRow, knapAux, getD_replicate_zero]
  | cons w ws ih =>
    intro vs cap c hc
    cases vs with
    | nil => simp [knapRow, knapAux, getD_replicate_zero]
    | cons v vs =>
      have hlt : c < cap + 1 := by omega
      simp only [knapRow]
      rw [getD_map_range _ _ _ hlt, ih vs cap c hc]
      by_cases hw : w ≤ c
      · rw [if_pos hw, ih vs cap (c - w) (by omega)]
        simp only [knapAux, if_pos hw]
      · rw [if_neg hw]
        simp only [knapAux, if_neg hw]
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem knapsack_01_postcond_satisfied (weights values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat)
    (h_precond : knapsack_01_precond weights values capacity) :
    knapsack_01_postcond weights values capacity (knapsack_01 weights values capacity h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hdp : knapsack_01 weights values capacity h_precond = knapAux weights values capacity :=
    knapRow_getD weights values capacity capacity (le_refl _)
  rw [hdp]
  constructor
  · rintro selected ⟨hlen, hw⟩
    exact knapAux_ub weights values capacity selected hlen hw
  · obtain ⟨s, hl, hwt, hv⟩ := knapAux_ex weights values capacity
    exact ⟨s, ⟨hl, hwt⟩, hv⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof

`./check.sh` prints **LEAN VERIFIED**.

## What was implemented

**Algorithm** (`auxcode`, `code`) — a genuine bottom-up 0/1 knapsack DP:
- `knapAux ws vs c` — the knapsack recurrence: `max(skip item, if wᵢ ≤ c then vᵢ + best(rest, c − wᵢ))`.
- `knapRow ws vs cap` — the DP **table**: processes each item once, turning the previous capacity row (length `cap+1`) into the next one via the standard transition `dp'[c] = max(dp[c], vᵢ + dp[c−wᵢ])`.
- `knapsack_01 = (knapRow weights values capacity).getD capacity 0`.

**Lemmas** (`lemma`):
- `knapAux_ub` — every valid selection's value is ≤ the recurrence (induction on items, case-splitting on take/skip).
- `knapAux_ex` — a valid selection achieving exactly that value exists (constructed explicitly, `false`-padded in the degenerate branch).
- `knapRow_getD` — the DP table entry at capacity `c ≤ cap` equals `knapAux ws vs c`, so the table is not a stand-in for the spec.
- Supporting index lemmas (`getD_replicate_zero`, `getD_map_range`) are proved, not stubbed.

**Proof** (`proof`) — rewrites the table lookup to the recurrence via `knapRow_getD`, then discharges both postcondition conjuncts.

## Semantic audit

- Both postconditions (Upper Bound, Existence) proved about the actual returned value; postcond/precond blocks untouched, all six markers preserved.
- No `sorry`/`admit`/axioms/`partial`/`unsafe` in editable regions; no `Nat.find`, `Classical.choose`, `decide`, sorting, or subset enumeration.
- Selections are `List Bool` of length exactly `weights.length` — the existence witness always has the required full length (including the `values = []` branch, where an all-`false` replicate is used).
- Edge cases: empty item lists → `0`; `capacity = 0` → row of length 1, zero-weight items still selectable; unequal-length lists (outside the precondition) are handled by the recursion's base cases, so nothing was weakened. Values are `Nat`, so there is no all-negative case; the "take nothing" selection always exists and bounds the result below by 0.
